item.title: Bitcoin-utvinning og norsk kraft på seminar i Oslo
item.title_en: Bitcoin mining and Norwegian power at Oslo seminar
item.source_note: Kaupr is a news source only. Nordic Crypto does not treat Kaupr as a sponsor.
item.summary: Bitcoinpolitisk Institutt is gathering researchers, industry and politicians in Oslo for a free seminar on bitcoin mining and Norwegian power.
